services.desc: Vancouver's Salmon fishing is going to provide excellent action & entertainment for angler's in 2025. Besides having excellent YEAR ROUND saltwater fishing let's take a look at the next 5 months & what is on deck for all angler's. This summer will serve up an action packed Coho/Silver fishery that is already materializing in early June & will be a repeat of last year's epic run! One of the most entertaining time's of our season & excellent table fair as well. Early in July we will witness the arrival of a very large & voracious run of Pink Salmon to the southern gulf, on route to one of many local river beds situated around the lower mainland of Vancouver.
